corrections.text: The article's Performance changes paragraph states that TornadoVM 6.0's cold-start time fell 'from 114.1 milliseconds to 71.4 milliseconds, a 37% reduction.' This figure does not appear in the cited TornadoVM blog post or in any of the article's other sources. The blog post does mention an unrelated one-time cost of roughly 13.5 milliseconds for the first Foreign Function & Memory API downcall to link, which is a different metric describing a different phenomenon. The cold-start figures should be disregarded; they could not be verified against any source.
